attchmntText: Nandani Creation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "Nandani Creation Limited Reports Strong Growth, Driven by Expanding Retail Presence".
voiceSummary: Nandani Creation Limited, trading as Jaipur Kurti on the NSE, filed a press release on November 16, 2026, reporting its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 increased by 29 percent year-on-year to 36.5 crore rupees. Profit after tax rose by 33 percent to 0.4 crore rupees. Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization grew by 22 percent to 2.4 crore rupees. The company announced Project 50, aiming to expand its exclusive brand outlet network from 18 to 50 stores by March 31, 2027. Five new stores opened in October 2026 in Jaipur, Delhi, Gurugram, Jammu, and Ludhiana. Average selling price improved to approximately 2,459 rupees in the first half of fiscal year 2027. Own channels contributed 32 percent of sales, third-party online marketplaces contributed 36 percent, third-party retail contributed 29 percent, and quick commerce contributed 3 percent.

attchmntText: Nandani Creation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Nandani Creation Limited, trading as Jaipur Kurt, approved its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors held its meeting on November 14, 2026, from 5:00 P.M. to 6:20 P.M. to review and approve these results. The Statutory Auditors have issued a Limited Review Report on these financials, which was also placed before the Board. The company confirms there are no deviations or variations in the utilization of funds raised through the conversion of warrants into equity shares on September 22, 28, and 29, 2026. A total amount of Rs 239.25 Lacs was raised for working capital requirements, and the full amount was utilized by September 30, 2026. The financial results and related reports will be published in newspapers and made available on the company and stock exchange websites.
